description: Force-refresh a company from upstream source registers. Useful when the caller suspects stale data, or after a recent change in ORSR. Respects a per-IČO 60 s cooldown. Returns the refreshed company record. Default sources: ruz, rpo, orsr.

sources.description: Comma-separated list of sources to refresh. Allowed: ruz, rpo, orsr, fs-dph. Example: "ruz,rpo". Default: "ruz,rpo,orsr".

name: refresh_company
